name.title: Business name
name.description: The business or place name exactly as shown on Google Maps.

address.title: Full address
address.description: Street address including city, state, and postal code, as returned by Google Maps. May be null for businesses that hide their address.
address.example: 9330 Lyndon B Johnson Fwy #900, Dallas, TX 75243, United States

rating.title: Star rating
rating.description: Google star rating from 1.0 to 5.0, or null for businesses with too few reviews to have a rating.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Public phone number in international format, from the Google Maps listing. Use for cold calling or as a fallback when no email is found.

website.title: Website URL
website.description: The official website URL the email was extracted from.

email.title: Contact email
email.description: The public contact email scraped directly from the business's own website (homepage or contact page). Pulled the same way a human visitor would see it. Not verified for deliverability and not sourced from any private or enrichment database. Only leads with a found email are returned.

overview.title: Email leads
overview.description: One row per business with a found public contact email.
